open_version_questions: Confirm from ClinicalTrials.gov document history and the original UIUC IRB or grant archive that the same-title, same-investigator documents dated 2018-04-06 are the governing outcome-uninformed pair for NCT03505658/15503; neither PDF prints the registry or protocol identifier and the trial began in 2015.
review_requirements: Adjudicate the protocol target of 250 whole families versus the SAP and registry target of 500 families, and confirm the family-level allocation unit.
Define allocation ratio, site or cycle stratification, concealment, analysis populations and parent-child-family record binding.
Resolve continuous BMI-percentile inference versus stable-or-negative-change responder wording and specify the growth-reference derivation.
Separate the confirmatory randomized mixed model from exploratory multilevel mixture and data-driven model-selection procedures.
Specify site effects, covariance, contrasts, estimand, missing-data and MNAR sensitivity methods.
Inventory and score all secondary outcomes, define multiplicity and reproduce primary-outcome power with clustering.
Define proportionate safety monitoring and verify every locator against one-based rendered physical PDF pages.
